purpose: Investigate the magnitude of a performance allowance and the credibility of the demand response. Designs fixed before new results; prior analyses known.
demand_choices: Same corrected sample and five whole-listing SHA256 folds. Alternative category-week interactions already motivated in prior audits; C10 tests shrinkage. No-initial tests reliance on initial-price quality controls.
counterfactual: Exact integer ask shifts -10,-5,+5,+10 on continuation listings, include own-peer and entrant spillovers.
linear_probability_controls: Same continuous regressors as baseline; absorb listed effects exactly; cluster by product category and date. Descriptive checks, not causal identification or probability models for cost inversion.
support: For each shift compare proposed price to observed GP category-week min/max. Report exposure and counterfactual quantity-change shares outside this range. This is a diagnostic; min/max membership is not conditional overlap.
calibration: Seven-calendar-day block bootstrap of fixed out-of-fold predictions for sales count and mean-receipt discrepancies. Descriptive conditional-on-fit intervals, not demand parameter confidence sets.
adjustment_model: Unknown nonnegative constant dollar adjustment cost K_g per phone-model review, estimated jointly with unrestricted nonnegative listing costs. Actual adjustment gain against previous fresh quote >= K_g; ignored simple price change gain on inaction dates <= K_g. Plus model aggregate nonnegative contribution. No arbitrary regret percentage.
eligible_model_days: Every retained current listing has a consecutive fresh prior quote. This excludes entrants/gaps and November-19-as-previous. Repricing means any current price differs from prior. Batch schedule is a proxy for review opportunity, not a fact.
adjustment_scope: Calibrate K_g using observed changes on qualifying review dates, and inaction on qualifying review dates. Models without both an observed change and inaction do not have a data-disciplined K_g; report separately.
limitations: No source can establish a finite upper regret allowance just by reporting average revenue improvements. A price adjustment model is an additional economic restriction and may be rejected. Do not relax it after seeing infeasibility.
adjustment_extra_variant: Complete-menu version additionally compares chosen adjusted prices with the four alternatives at zero additional slack on adjustment days. This is stronger than the primary inaction/change restriction. Both assume one-day incremental profits suffice; multi-day investment returns are omitted.
